title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-feb-2026
content:
Meeting: Cross-functional roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML)
Scheduled: 2026-02-19 10:00am PT (30m)
Owner (notes): Maya Chen
Attendees (requested): Ben R (serving runtime), Priya N (product-hosted-api), Ethan P (applied-ml), Sofia M (platform eng), possible: Aaron (SRE)
Goals for this sync:
- Align priorities for H1 features that impact serving/runtime and model onboarding (model quantization, batching changes, rollout policies).
- Surface infra/capacity constraints that could shift timelines (GPU reservations, burst capacity).
- Agree on evaluation/metrics gating for rollout (p95 latency target, quality regressions on eval set).
- Define concrete action items and owners post-meeting.

Agenda (rough, keep tight)
1) 0-5m quick context: Product priorities + target timelines (Priya)
2) 5-15m Eng constraints and risks (Ben / Sofia)
   - Dedicated GPU pool availability, autoscaling windows
   - Known perf risks for new quantization profiles
3) 15-22m Applied ML requirements (Ethan)
   - Model variant quality tradeoffs, eval pass/fail criteria, prompt sets to use
4) 22-28m Rollouts & observability checklist (all)
   - Metrics to watch, fallback model plan, tracing hooks, error thresholds
5) 28-30m Quick recap + next steps (Maya)

Prep notes / context to call out (for me)
- Product wants faster rollout of the 1.5B -> 300M quantized variant for cost savings in Hosted API by Apr. Need to confirm: does runtime already support required kernels for 300M quantized with fused attention? (ask Ben)
- Applied ML requires a stable eval harness run for the top-5 prompts + new real-user prompt set. They want automated regression alerts tied to prompt sets. Need timeline from Ethan for first complete eval run (estimate: 2 weeks after model build).
- Platform/infra: Sofia mentioned capacity limits in eu-west-1 for Dedicated until March due to fleet maintenance. This could block certain customer pilot rollouts. Confirm exact blackout dates.
- SLO targets: Product proposed p95 < 180ms for short-chat routes, p95 < 800ms for long-sequence generation. Need engineering feasibility check and what batching configs would look like.
- Risk: If we enable aggressive batching to hit cost targets, tail latencies could spike for small requests. Discuss fallback policies and SLA communication.

Open questions to raise
- Ben/Sofia: Which quantization profiles are safe to test in Hosted vs Dedicated initially? Any profiles that must be restricted to Dedicated/private?
- Ethan: What does the minimum eval pass look like (metrics + thresholds)? Who signs off for quality?
- Priya: Product priority ranking: should cost-first (reduce per-token cost) or latency-first for April milestone? Implications for rollout strategy.
- Ops: What change windows are available for pushing runtime kernel updates? (impact on release plan)

My notes-to-self (talking points)
- Emphasize need for a cut-over plan with canary + automatic fallback; suggest a 5% canary, 30 min observe, then 25% increments with quality checks at each step.
- Ask for a short doc on capacity assumptions used in the roadmap (expected QPS, mean seq len) so we can sanity-check autoscaler settings.
- Remind team about cost visibility: token-level cost breakdown will be useful to show product to quantify savings from quantization.

Proposed immediate actions to propose in meeting (and who I'd suggest)
- (Ben) Share short checklist of quantization profiles tested and known perf numbers by 2026-02-26.
- (Ethan) Run the eval harness on the 300M quantized build and share results + failure cases by 2026-02-28.
- (Sofia) Confirm eu-west-1 Dedicated maintenance window dates and any capacity reservations by 2026-02-20.
- (Priya) Re-prioritize roadmap doc with explicit tradeoffs (cost vs latency) and share updated priorities by 2026-02-21.
- (Maya) Draft rollout playbook (canary percentages, metrics, rollback criteria) and circulate by 2026-02-22.

Follow-up tracking (how I'll monitor)
- Quick Slack thread #roadmap-sync with labels to track each bullet above.
- Add a short checklist in Confluence page (linked) and update as each owner marks done.

Notes to capture during meeting (placeholders)
- Ben: "kernel X not ready for quantization profile Y until mid-March"
- Ethan: "eval harness currently covers 80% of prompt diversity; need examples from Prod logs for the rest"
- Sofia: "autoscaler tuning will need small increases in headroom during rollout window"

Potential blockers (call these out fast)
- Regulatory/customer data isolation that forces some models into Private (will impact Hosted cost strategy)
- Third-party library compatibility for fused kernels (could delay quantization timeline)

Post-meeting quick checklist (to update in doc)
- Capture decisions (priority order, timelines)
- Record owners + deadlines in JIRA tickets (create if missing)
- Schedule a follow-up narrower sync in 2 weeks (implementation-focused)

Random scratch notes (ignore unless useful)
- Consider small A/B on routing by policy: route lower-priority traffic to quantized variant to measure real-world quality impact without customer-wide rollout.
- If latency SLOs fail, fallback strategy could be region-based (use dedicated region with faster hardware)

---
Bottom-line: keep meeting tight, aim to leave with 3 concrete owner-driven deliverables in next 7-10 days.

Action items (quick list for after meeting)
- Create/update Confluence checklist + link to JIRA tickets (Maya)
- Owners above to post status in #roadmap-sync by their dates
- Schedule 30m follow-up implementation sync (Maya)


[end of prep notes]
